comparison.objective: Install a rack bracket, versus release a screwdriver from a spring clamp and hold it.
comparison.physical_skill: Inside-frame alignment/latching versus clamp release and controlled extraction while stabilizing the base.
comparison.success_condition: Self-supporting bracket with all mounts engaged versus tool clear of the clamp, securely pinched at a target pose, with no base displacement or drop.
comparison.reason: Different mechanism and endpoint despite both involving release-sensitive hardware.
